From Wiktionary, the free dictionary
See also: ciclistă

Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French cycliste.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [siˈklis.tə]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [siˈklis.ta]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)

Noun

[edit]

ciclista m or f by sense (plural ciclistes)

  1. cyclist, biker

Further reading

[edit]
  • “ciclista” in Diccionari català-valencià-balear, Antoni Maria Alcover and Francesc de Borja Moll, 1962.

Galician

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From French cycliste.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Audio:(file)

Noun

[edit]

ciclista m or f by sense (plural ciclistas)

  1. cyclist, biker

Related terms

[edit]
  • ciclismo

Adjective

[edit]

ciclista m or f (plural ciclistas)

  1. cycling

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Calque of French cycliste.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /t͡ʃiˈklis.ta/
  • Rhymes: -ista
  • Hyphenation: ci‧clì‧sta

Noun

[edit]

ciclista m or f by sense (masculine plural ciclisti, feminine plural cicliste)

  1. cyclist, biker
    Coordinate term: velocipedista

Related terms

[edit]
  • monociclista
  • ciclismo
  • ciclistico

Further reading

[edit]
  • ciclista in Treccani.it – Vocabolario Treccani on line, Istituto dell'Enciclopedia Italiana

Anagrams

[edit]
  • clastici

Occitan

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Audio (Béarn):(file)

Noun

[edit]

ciclista m or f (plural ciclistas) (Languedoc, Limousin)

  1. cyclist (someone who rides a bicycle)

Related terms

[edit]
  • bicicleta
  • ciclisme

See also

[edit]
  • velò (Limousin), vèlo (Languedoc)
  • velocipède (Languedoc)

Further reading

[edit]
  • Diccionari General de la Lenga Occitana‎[1], L’Academia occitana – Consistòri del Gai Saber, 2008-2025, page 164

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French cycliste.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /siˈklis.tɐ/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /siˈklis.tɐ/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /siˈkliʃ.tɐ/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /siˈklis.ta/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /siˈkliʃ.tɐ/

  • Rhymes: (Brazil) -istɐ, (Portugal, Rio de Janeiro) -iʃtɐ
  • Hyphenation: ci‧clis‧ta

Noun

[edit]

ciclista m or f by sense (plural ciclistas)

  1. biker; cyclist (a person who rides a bicycle)
    Synonym: velocipedista

Adjective

[edit]

ciclista m or f (plural ciclistas)

  1. cycling

Further reading

[edit]
  • “ciclista”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “ciclista”, in Dicionário inFormal (in Portuguese), 2006–2026
  • “ciclista” in Dicionário Aberto based on Novo Diccionário da Língua Portuguesa de Cândido de Figueiredo, 1913
  • “ciclista”, in Dicionário infopédia da Lingua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Porto: Porto Editora, 2003–2026
  • “ciclista”, in Michaelis Dicionário Brasileiro da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), São Paulo: Editora Melhoramentos, 2015–2026, →ISBN
  • “ciclista”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Romanian

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

ciclista f

  1. definite nominative/accusative singular of ciclistă

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Calque of French cycliste.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /θiˈklista/ [θiˈklis.t̪a] (Equatorial Guinea, Spain)
  • IPA(key): /siˈklista/ [siˈklis.t̪a] (Latin America, Philippines)
  • Rhymes: -ista
  • Syllabification: ci‧clis‧ta

Noun

[edit]

ciclista m or f by sense (plural ciclistas)

  1. cyclist, biker

Related terms

[edit]
  • ciclismo

Descendants

[edit]
  • → Cebuano: siklista
  • → Tagalog: siklista

Adjective

[edit]

ciclista m or f (masculine and feminine plural ciclistas)

  1. cycling

Further reading

[edit]
  • “ciclista”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025
